summary: Form field that holds violet-radio children and submits the one selected value; use for a single choice among a few visible options.

usage.text: Set the group's value to a radio's value to select it; with no group value, a radio marked checked is used. The group overwrites each radio's checked state, tabindex and, when it has a name, its name.

A click delivers two change events to a group listener: the group's own (detail.value) and the clicked radio's bubbling one (detail.checked). Keyboard selection delivers only the group's. Check event.target.
The group is one tab stop. Arrow keys, Home and End move focus and select in the same step, skipping disabled radios and wrapping at the ends.

a11y.text: An aria-label on the host takes precedence over the label attribute as the group's name; the label stays visible.
The rendered error message is linked to the group as its error message, and the supporting text as its description.
